deskyard zoom: PNG of a region at full resolution

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] zoom X0 Y0 X1 Y1 [FILE|-]

Takes a PNG of just the region from the top-left corner X0 Y0 to the
bottom-right corner X1 Y1 (exclusive), at full resolution: use it to read
small text or check details. X1 must be greater than X0 and Y1 greater than
Y0.

Arguments:
  X0         integer     required  left edge
  Y0         integer     required  top edge
  X1         integer     required  right edge (greater than x0)
  Y1         integer     required  bottom edge (greater than y0)
  FILE       path        optional  where to write the PNG on this machine; - or omitted for stdout

Prints: PNG image bytes on stdout, or nothing when FILE is given (the file is
  written on this machine)

Examples:
  deskyard zoom 100 50 420 290 detail.png

Where: inside an environment it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen environment (-e ENV)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
